entries.title: Docs Librarian Persona Needed

entries.title: E2E Substrate Failures Need Triage Before Code Blame
entries.guardrail_change: existing E2E readiness guidance and current root routing
entries.signal_summary: Historical E2E runs exposed substrate failures that looked like product failures at first glance: unavailable Docker capacity, Incus provider setup, SSH/auth drift, missing bootstrapped dependencies, or shared lease-pool waits.
entries.reappearance_check: If agents still misclassify substrate failures, move this from documentation into Slice 8 by adding agent-native failure hints to the E2E preflight or lane failure output.

entries.title: Ephemeral Signals Lose Recurrence Context
entries.signal_summary: The user pointed out that signals should not all be ephemeral. Across ten worktrees, recurring signals are useful evidence: they show whether a guardrail worked, whether the same issue is reappearing, and whether the guardrail needs to...
entries.reappearance_check: If agents keep reporting signals only in final prose without adding or updating records, make signal-ledger checks part of a reviewer persona or static docs check.

entries.title: Guardrail Target Terminology Was Clearer Than Sink
entries.signal_summary: The initial feedback-loop docs used "sink" as the destination for a distilled signal. The user pointed out that loop engineering is about creating guardrails, and that "guardrail target" better communicates both guidance and prevention.
entries.reappearance_check: If "sink" reappears in harness docs, treat it as terminology drift and replace it unless the context is unrelated to the feedback-loop model.

entries.title: Handoff Needs Next Step
entries.signal_summary: The user pointed out that completion reports should include the next slice or next concrete step. The orchestrator should not make the user ask what comes after a finished loop-engineering slice.
entries.reappearance_check: If a future completion report omits the next slice or next concrete step, mark this record `recurring` and tighten the relevant report template or reviewer persona.

entries.title: JSON Envelope Assumptions Hide Real Command Results

entries.reappearance_check: If this affects another command implementation or release report, mark this record `recurring`, add the command and result shape here, and consider a deterministic command-contract test for the affected command.

entries.title: Release Boundaries Require Explicit Approval
entries.guardrail_change: current root goal contract and release routing row
entries.signal_summary: Release work can slide from candidate verification into merge, push, tag, publish, or live fleet mutation if the approval boundary is not written down before work starts.
entries.reappearance_check: If release work again crosses into unapproved merge, tag, publish, or live mutation, mark this record `recurring` and tighten the release skill itself.

entries.title: Review Persona Needs Workflow Hook
entries.signal_summary: The first CLI reviewer persona existed and was discoverable through root routing, but the implementation workflow did not yet explicitly initiate it. That made the persona too passive: future agents could skip it unless they manually...
entries.reappearance_check: If a future implementation skips an applicable reviewer persona, mark this record `recurring` and move the persona invocation into a stricter pre-commit check or reviewer gate.

entries.title: Routine Review Scope Is Changed Files
entries.signal_summary: The user clarified that routine review should inspect changed files and cited evidence, not constantly review the entire project. Project-wide patterns are context for judging the diff, while full audits are separate tasks.
entries.reappearance_check: If a routine reviewer expands into a broad project audit without the user asking for one, mark this record `recurring` and add the changed-files rule to the specific reviewer persona that drifted.

entries.title: Signal Ledger Needs Curation
entries.signal_summary: The user pointed out that durable signals can grow without bound. If old or overlapping signals stay in the ledger, they make feature development harder by adding noise and stale guidance.
entries.reappearance_check: If the ledger becomes noisy again, run a focused curation pass over the matching records. If that keeps happening, add a review-persona check or lightweight script that flags stale, redundant, or long-unreviewed records.
